Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1125
Claimant:
Sarah Walters
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
5-25-24
First notice of loss was received for a side impact at an intersection, with the claimant reporting neck and back strain.
The claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact will be routed through the attorney's office.
6-7-24
Photos taken at the scene show damage that lines up with the described impact, and the vehicle damage is
consistent with a side collision. The file has no independent witness statements, so the photos carry most of the
weight at this stage.
7-26-24
Police report confirms the clamiant was in the vehicle at the time of the crash. The responding officer's notes match
the basic sequence of events given at intake.
8-19-24
The claimant's account of the collision has stayed the same in every conversation so far, including the initial call and
the recorded statement. No change in the description of how the crash happened has been noted.
8-25-24
Records search shows no earlier damage to the vehicle on file, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start
of coverage. The driver is a member of the policyholder's household and is covered as such.
9-16-24
Medical records were requested through counsel. No prior injury to the neck or back has been identified in the
claimant's history, and the reported strain is a plausible result of a crash of this type.
10-6-24
Treatment followed a typical course of care, with the claimant attending scheduled visits and progressing steadily.
The treating provider's notes show symptoms easing over the period of care.
12-6-24
Treatment has tapered as the claimant improved, and the most recent records show fewer visits and reduced
reported pain. Current status is being monitored against the medical file.
12-23-24
File reviewed. Vehicle damage, police confirmation of the claimant's presence, consistent accounts, and medical
course all align with the reported loss, and the claim remains open pending final medical documentation from
counsel.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
